about_the_game:
House Fighters: Total Mess is a playful arcade dogfighting game. Hop into a toy plane, zip through cozy rooms, and turn everyday objects into thrilling battlegrounds. No complicated controls, just pure, lighthearted aerial chaos. Weave between bookshelves, dodge towering lamps, and outmaneuver tiny enemies in fast-paced, feel-good combat.

Dodge, weave, and strike in high-speed dogfights. Use rockets, bombs, and even household items to outmaneuver your toy-sized foes.

Customize your fighter with playful stickers, wacky weapons, and unexpected upgrades. Experiment and find the perfect loadout for every mission.

Chase, dodge, and loop through playful missions where every room holds a new challenge. Sneak past towering obstacles, weave through tight spaces, and take on clever little foes in fast, lighthearted dogfights.

  • OS: Ubuntu >= 20.04, Arch, or similar
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen
  • Graphics: Radeon R9 270, GeForce GTX 670, Intel Iris Xe, or similar.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: OS X 10.11.x
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or higher
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or higher
